test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 04 Nov, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

He hardness ever / complains about / his workload because / he enjoys his job.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error lies in the phrase "He hardness ever". The word "hardness" is incorrect here. The correct word should be "hardly," which means "barely" or "almost never." "Hardness" is a noun, whereas an adverb is needed in this context to modify the verb "complains."
 
• The correct phrase should be "He hardly ever" to correctly convey the idea that he rarely complains.
 
• Other parts of the sentence are grammatically correct and do not need any changes.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"He hardly ever complains about his workload because he enjoys his job."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "he enjoys his job" **– This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not contain any errors.
 
• **Option 2: "his workload because" **– This part of the sentence is correct as it is properly linking the reason for not complaining about his workload.
 
• **Option 4: "complains about" **– This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not need any changes.
